mission.name.label: NAME
mission.name.description: The mission pack's name, or the session's brief name outside a pack.

mission.date.label: DATE
mission.date.description: The date of the first departure in the flow, else the date the brief is generated.

mission.distance.label: DISTANCE
mission.distance.description: The routes' total distance in the flow.

mission.flightTime.label: FLIGHT TIME
mission.flightTime.description: The routes' total time enroute in the flow (h+mm).

flight.aircraft.label: AIRCRAFT
flight.aircraft.description: How many aircraft of which airframe: the most aircraft placed on any LZ/PZ in the flow, by airframe ("4 × UH-60L").

flight.summary.label: MISSION
flight.summary.description: One sentence of the whole mission: the aircraft, where from, each stop by role, and the return time.

packet.pages.label: PAGES
packet.pages.description: The number of pages planned: one a step, and one each appendix page (strip charts three to a page). The printed PDF runs longer where a step takes two pages, so a brief never says it.

packet.inventory.label: PACKET
packet.inventory.description: What the packet holds, by section and count, never by page: the brief's steps, the LZ/PZ cards, nav logs, strip charts and the IIMC card.

weather.summary.label: WEATHER
weather.summary.description: Weather at takeoff, enroute and arrival, each with its station and whether it is an observation or a forecast for the planned time.

weather.departure.label: WX TAKEOFF
weather.departure.description: The report or forecast for the departure point at the takeoff time.

weather.enroute.label: WX ENROUTE
weather.enroute.description: The winds aloft and temperature along the routes (from the route planner's winds).

weather.arrival.label: WX ARRIVAL
weather.arrival.description: The report or forecast for the last stop at its arrival time.

light.summary.label: LIGHT
light.summary.description: BMNT, sunrise, sunset, EENT, moonrise, moonset and illumination in one line.

light.bmnt.label: BMNT
light.bmnt.description: Begin morning nautical twilight (sun 12° below the horizon) at the departure point on the mission date.

light.sunrise.label: SUNRISE
light.sunrise.description: Sunrise at the departure point on the mission date.

light.sunset.label: SUNSET
light.sunset.description: Sunset at the departure point on the mission date.

light.eent.label: EENT
light.eent.description: End evening nautical twilight at the departure point on the mission date.

light.moonrise.label: MOONRISE
light.moonrise.description: Moonrise at the departure point on the mission date; none if it does not rise that day.

light.moonset.label: MOONSET
light.moonset.description: Moonset at the departure point on the mission date; none if it does not set that day.

light.illumination.label: ILLUM
light.illumination.description: The moon's illuminated fraction at the takeoff time, as a whole percentage (the series is good to about 0.2%).

notams.summary.label: NOTAMS
notams.summary.description: How many NOTAMs near the departure point, the stops and the routes, and the kinds; or that they could not be searched.

threats.summary.label: THREATS
threats.summary.description: The threats in the brief: each one's name and where it lies from the nearest route. Needs step T.

timeline.label: TIMELINE
timeline.description: Every stop and route in the flow, in order, with its time.

departure.point.label: DEPART
departure.point.description: Where the flow starts: the first route's first point, or the first stop.

departure.time.label: TAKEOFF
departure.time.description: The takeoff time: the first route's clock at its first point.

departure.commoCheck.label: COMMO CHECK
departure.commoCheck.description: The takeoff time less the standard commo check lead (standards: commoCheckMinutes).

departure.taxi.label: TAXI / LOAD
departure.taxi.description: The takeoff time less the standard taxi and load lead (standards: taxiLoadMinutes).

departure.lineup.label: LINEUP
departure.lineup.description: The takeoff time less the standard lineup lead (standards: lineupMinutes).

departure.fuel.label: FUEL REQ
departure.fuel.description: The fuel the route planner says the whole flow needs.

departure.plan.label: DEPARTURE
departure.plan.description: Route name, takeoff time, heading, altitude, airspeed of the first leg.

routes.enrouteAirspeed.label: ENROUTE
routes.enrouteAirspeed.description: The airspeed most legs of the routes are planned at (by distance).

routes.rpInboundAirspeed.label: RP IN
routes.rpInboundAirspeed.description: The airspeed planned from each RP to its stop, when every one agrees.

stops.goAround.label: GO-AROUND
stops.goAround.description: The go-around direction, when every LZ/PZ in the flow that has one agrees.

rally.points.label: RALLY
rally.points.description: The route points the brief names as rally points (chosen in Mission flow), inbound and outbound.

stop.role.label: ROLE
stop.role.description: Its role in the flow (PZ, LZ, FARP, holding area, laager, false insertion LZ).

stop.elevation.label: ELEV
stop.elevation.description: Its elevation, feet MSL, from its analysis.

stop.landingHeading.label: LAND
stop.landingHeading.description: The landing heading from its flight data (the landing doghouse).

stop.takeoffHeading.label: T/O
stop.takeoffHeading.description: The takeoff heading from its flight data (the takeoff doghouse).

stop.goAround.label: GO-AROUND
stop.goAround.description: The direction of its go-around graphic, if it has one.

stop.aircraft.label: AIRCRAFT
stop.aircraft.description: How many aircraft are placed on it, by airframe.

stop.arrive.label: ARRIVE
stop.arrive.description: When the route that ends at it arrives (its last point within 500 m of the target).

stop.inbound.label: INBOUND
stop.inbound.description: From the RP: its name and time, the airspeed, the distance and time to the stop, as a clause ("from RP1 at 12:19:45, 60 KIAS, 1.5 nm, 0+01+18").

stop.departurePlan.label: DEPARTURE
stop.departurePlan.description: The next route from it: name, takeoff time, heading, altitude, airspeed.

stop.slope.label: SLOPE
stop.slope.description: The slope tile's call and what it judged at the landing heading.

stop.weather.label: WEATHER
stop.weather.description: The weather report its weather tiles show.

route.summary.label: SUMMARY
route.summary.description: Its name, first and last named points, distance and time enroute.

route.overview.label: OVERVIEW
route.overview.description: Its named points in order with the leg's heading, distance and time to each.

route.start.label: START
route.start.description: Its clock at its first point.

route.end.label: END
route.end.description: Its clock at its last point.

route.airspeed.label: AIRSPEED
route.airspeed.description: Its planned airspeeds, by the points where they change.

route.altitude.label: ALTITUDE
route.altitude.description: Its planned altitudes (AGL or MSL as planned), by the points where they change.

route.checkpoints.label: CHECKPOINTS
route.checkpoints.description: Its named points with their types.

route.fuel.label: FUEL
route.fuel.description: The fuel the route planner says it uses.
